why_best: A progressive horizontal entry aligns perfectly with the natural scanning habits of a news audience while introducing key terms in sync with spoken commentary.
why_bad: Dropping the entire text block vertically or snapping it instantly onto the screen creates a chaotic visual jolt that distracts from the newsroom anchor.
trap: A flawed execution will drag out the horizontal travel distance, making the graphic feel sluggish rather than sharp and broadcast-ready.
